resources.string: Target-first diagnostic on the app network (which may traverse the active VPN). A TCP open proves only socket reachability. A TLS-verified handshake proves the SNI certificate and hostname for that connection, not an Xray profile or DNS leak safety. Domain names are resolved on this route. CIDR and range scans include all addresses. At most 128 targets; no automatic retries.
Targets (IP, hostname, IPv4 CIDR or inclusive range)
Validate TLS certificate and SNI hostname
Explicit SNI (required for IP TLS; blank uses hostname for domain targets)
Scan %1$d targets with at most %2$d sockets, %3$d ms timeout per target, in %4$s mode? These app-network requests may traverse an active VPN. No VPN profile or tunnel state will be changed.

Invalid target plan, port, timeout or SNI. Use explicit IPv4, single IPv6, DNS hostnames, IPv4 CIDR or full-address IPv4 ranges. At most 128 targets; broad ranges are rejected, never truncated. TLS on literal IPs needs an explicit domain SNI.
Cannot verify the current default-network session. No sockets were opened. This diagnostic needs Android 7 or later with an available default network.
Route: app network; may traverse a device VPN. Not a proxy or DNS leak test.
Network changed during the scan; it was stopped. Measurements are historical, not current-route proof.
Scan stopped. Unfinished targets are unknown, not failures.
The report contains the tested IP addresses, hostnames, SNI names, statuses and times. The selected sharing app will receive that information. Continue?
